reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraph (§3(b), invoicing/supporting-detail obligation running from Contractor to Company) supports the rationale that the Agreement imposes no audit, inspection or verification right on the Customer; compensation and substantiation obligations flow from Contractor to Company.
No redline or counterparty comment is expected for a compliant finding, and the rendered text is unchanged — correct, minimal (zero) edit.

The failed deterministic check ('audit frequency limited') is an artifact of compliance-by-absence: there is no audit clause to which frequency/notice/cost limits could attach, so the regex miss is not evidence of a defect.

Absence of any audit right binding us is at least as protective as the preferred position (once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, Vendor cost, no system access), and the only access provision cited runs in our favor, so no negotiation issue should be raised.
